audit.whatIsWrong: The page repeatedly says 'she can't escape your W stun once you're on her' and never mentions that Unraveled Earth's mines detonate and STUN you if you dash through them — the single most Pantheon-relevant fact in her kit. Cooldowns field had no digits. Twelve pronoun lint hits. Her Q/E/R hard CC also cancels your Aegis channel (missingInteractions).
audit.why: Riot text: 'If enemies dash through it... the mines explode and stun them.' Pantheon W and R are dashes. E is flat 14s, W 14/12.5/11/9.5/8.
